<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[South Thailand insurgency]]
**Joint bomb and gun attacks kill at least two in [[Narathiwat Province|Narathiwat]], [[Pattani Province|Pattani]], and [[Songkhla Province]]s of [[Thailand]], the latest in a long string of such attacks. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-south-attacks-idUSKBN17L243?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Kamwina Nsapu rebellion]]
**At least 17 new mass graves are discovered  by [[United Nations]] investigators in [[Kasaï-Central]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], mostly around the town of [[Tshimbulu]]. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/04/17-mass-graves-central-drc-170419132935786.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economics
* [[21st Century Fox]], the parent company of [[Fox News]], announces the firing of Fox News commentator [[Bill O'Reilly (political commentator)|Bill O'Reilly]]. [http://money.cnn.com/2017/04/19/media/bill-oreilly-out-fox-news/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-39647434 (BBC)]
*Citing a drop in demand, the [[Dubai]]-based, [[United Arab Emirates]]-owned airline [[Emirates (airline)|Emirates Air]] announces a cut in flights to five of its 12 U.S. destinations.  The airline’s Dubai hub, third-busiest in the world, is a major stop for travelers in countries affected by [[Executive Order 13769|President Donald Trump’s travel ban]], and is also one of several Middle East airports affected by a U.S. ban on tablets, laptops, and similar devices in the passenger cabin. [http://www.latimes.com/world/la-fg-emirates-flights-20170419-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 17 people are killed after an [[Andean]] [[landslide]] strikes the [[Colombia]]n city of [[Manizales]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-landslide-idUSKBN17L24K?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/04/20/colombia-landslide-kills-least-17-rains-lash-andes/ (Reuters via ''The Telegraph'')]
*Four [[Hellenic Army]] officers are killed and one is injured when their [[Bell UH-1 Iroquois]] border patrol helicopter crashes near [[Elassona]] in northern [[Greece]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170420183425/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/greece-dead-hurt-army-helicopter-crash-46881330 (ABC News)]

;Law and crime
*Former [[New England Patriots]] player [[Aaron Hernandez]], acquitted last week of a 2012 double murder but serving a life sentence for a [[Murder of Odin Lloyd|2013 murder]], is found hanged in his [[Souza-Baranowski Correctional Center|prison]] cell, and is pronounced dead an hour later. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2017/04/19/aaron-hernandez-former-nfl-player-found-dead-in-prison-cell-officials-say.html (Fox News)]
*[[Disappearance of Etan Patz#Case reopened|Pedro Hernandez]], convicted in February 2017 for the May 25, 1979 death of [[Disappearance of Etan Patz|Etan Patz]] in the [[SoHo]] neighborhood of [[Manhattan]], was sentenced yesterday to 25 years to life imprisonment. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/04/18/nyregion/pedro-hernandez-etan-patz-sentencing.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Nigeria]]n spy chief [[Ayo Oke]] has been suspended by President [[Muhammadu Buhari]] after anti-corruption agents uncovered more than $43 million in cash at his flat in [[Lagos]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-39646256 (BBC)]
*Three senior figures in the [[Bharatiya Janata Party]], [[L.K. Advani]], [[Uma Bharati]] and [[Murli Manohar Joshi]], will be tried for their alleged role in the destruction of the [[Babri Masjid]] Mosque in the northern [[India]]n town of [[Ayodhya]]. [http://edition.cnn.com/2017/04/19/asia/india-mosque-demolition-conspiracy/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Jakarta gubernatorial election, 2017]]
**Indonesian voters in [[Jakarta]] return to the polls for the second round of a [[List of Governors of Jakarta|gubernatorial]] election between incumbent [[Basuki Tjahaja Purnama]], whose alleged [[Quran desecration|blasphemy]] sparked [[November 2016 Jakarta protests|mass protests]] in November, and [[Anies Baswedan]]. Opinion polls give Baswedan a narrow lead. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-04-18/jakarta-governor-election-to-go-ahead-amid-tensions/8448100 (ABC News)]
**Jakarta's current governor, Basuki Tjahaja Purnama, concedes to Muslim former government minister Anies Baswedan. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-39636974 (BBC)]
*[[French presidential election, 2017]]
**The closely-watched [[CEVIPOF]] poll shows [[Emmanuel Macron]] and [[Marine Le Pen]] clinging to a narrow lead heading into the first stage of the election, with Le Pen recently becoming embroiled in a spat with the [[European Commission]] after refusing to appear on [[TF1]] while there remained a [[Flag of Europe]] in the background. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-election-idUSKBN17L0MY?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[German federal election, 2017]]
**[[Alternative for Germany]] chairwoman [[Frauke Petry]] announces that she will not lead the party in the September federal election, citing other party leaders' insistence on remaining a "fundamental opposition party", unwilling to join a coalition. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-election-afd-idUSKBN17L1LC?il=0 (Reuters)]
**A [[Forsa Institute]] poll shows the lowest level of support for the [[Alliance 90/The Greens|Greens]] in nearly 15 years, weakening the chances of a left-leaning coalition taking power from the [[CDU/CSU]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-election-poll-idUSKBN17L0PZ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[United Kingdom general election, 2017]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] [[House of Commons]] approves by 522 votes to 13 a snap general election to be held on June 8. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-39640394 (BBC)]
*[[2014–17 Venezuelan protests]]
**[[Venezuela]]n security forces clash with opposition demonstrators in the so-called "Mother of All Marches" against [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] in [[Caracas]]. Two students and a National Guard sergeant are shot dead. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-idUSKBN17L178 (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-idUSKBN17L178?il=0 (Reuters²)]
*[[United States House of Representatives elections, 2018]]
**[[Utah]] representative [[Jason Chaffetz]], chairman of the [[United States House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform|House Oversight Committee]], announces that he will not run for re-election next year. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/powerpost/wp/2017/04/19/jason-chaffetz-announces-he-wont-run-for-office-in-2018/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Georgia's 6th congressional district special election, 2017]]
**Local Republican candidate [[Karen Handel]] says she wants [[Donald Trump]] to campaign for her in the district. [https://www.usnews.com/news/national-news/articles/2017-04-19/karen-handel-wants-trumps-help-in-georgia-runoff-vs-ossoff (''U.S. News and World Report'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Washington State University]] professor [[Peter Engels]] and his team announce they have created a fluid that displays [[negative mass]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-39642992 (BBC)]
*[[2014 JO25]], a [[Near-Earth object|near-Earth asteroid]] discovered by the [[Catalina Sky Survey]] in May 2014, passes within 1.8 million kilometers of the planet, the largest such asteroid to transit close to Earth since 2004. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-39642995 (BBC)]

;Sports
* A spokeswoman for [[tennis]] star [[Serena Williams]] confirms rumors that Williams is [[Pregnancy|pregnant]]. The 23-time [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] singles champion, who was apparently pregnant when she won [[2017 Australian Open – Women's Singles|this year's]] [[Australian Open]], is expected to give birth in September, and will not play again until 2018. [http://www.espn.com/tennis/story/_/id/19196017/serena-williams-pregnancy-confirmed-pr-rep (ESPN)]
